articles.title: Tigers have fewer stolen bases than any team since 2022. Can they unlock more speed?
articles.description: Detroit entered Monday tied for last in stolen bases, viewing steals as only part of its base-running philosophy. Might that be changing?

articles.title: Tigers have tough decisions mounting with Spencer Torkelson, Colt Keith and more
articles.description: Keith and Torkelson are platooning at first base, highlighting roster decisions that might be coming to a head.

articles.title: Tigers’ failures in pitching acquisitions are coming back to haunt them
articles.description: The Tigers have spent about $128.75 million on free-agent pitchers over the past two years. They have combined for only 4.8 fWAR.
